one_line: Rival warlords of the Shunga and Indo-Greek worlds at the Indo-Gangetic frontier, c. 2nd century BCE.

appearance.age_look: Pushyamitra appears in his late 40s with a solid, broad-shouldered build; Menander appears in his mid-30s with a tall, athletic frame.
appearance.face: Pushyamitra has a square face, wheatish-brown complexion, strong jaw, straight nose, thick brows, neatly groomed moustache and short beard, with a stern, commanding default expression; Menander has an oval face, light olive complexion, sharp nose, shorter beard stubble, defined cheekbones, and a focused, calm default expression with piercing eyes.
appearance.hair: Pushyamitra’s black hair is pulled back into a high, tight topknot (shikha-style) at the crown, front hair smoothed back, with a narrow saffron headband tied around the knot; Menander has wavy dark brown hair cut to the nape, brushed back from the forehead in Hellenistic style, with a simple bronze diadem band resting above his temples.
appearance.costume: Pushyamitra wears an era-appropriate north Indian elite warrior outfit: a knee-length off‑white cotton angarkha-style wrap tunic with overlapping front panel tied at the right, bordered with thin maroon piping, over a fitted sleeveless quilted cotton coat in muted mustard with simple stitched vertical channels; he has a wide maroon cloth belt wrapped twice around the waist and knotted at the left, plain dark brown cotton churidar-style trousers gathered at the ankles, and soft brown leather ankle boots with turned-down cuffs; over one shoulder he drapes a saffron woolen shawl (uttariya) with a subtle narrow red border, usually slung from his left shoulder across his torso; his forearms bear simple bronze bangles and he wears small gold stud earrings; Menander wears a Hellenistic military ensemble: a knee-length off‑white linen chiton (tunic) with short sleeves, cinched by a broad dark red leather belt, over which he has a fitted bronze muscle cuirass stylised in anime fashion but plausibly simple, with minimal engraved lines and a slightly greened patina; a short dark green woolen cloak (chlamys) is clasped at his right shoulder with a round bronze brooch and falls to mid-thigh; he wears knee-length dark brown leather boots with laced fronts, and his arms are protected by simple bronze bracers over the forearms; beneath the cuirass, a hint of a light blue border is visible at the tunic hem, echoing Greek textile taste without ornate fantasy patterns.
appearance.signature: Pushyamitra’s signature weapon is a long Indian bamboo bow with a gently recurved profile, medium-brown polished finish, carried with a cloth quiver of feathered arrows slung at his back, while Menander’s signature weapon is a straight Hellenistic iron spear (doru) with a leaf-shaped point and bronze butt-spike, usually held in his right hand.

ref_desc: Pushyamitra is a broad-shouldered, wheatish man with a high black topknot and saffron headband, in off-white angarkha, mustard quilted coat, maroon belt, churidar trousers and brown boots with saffron shawl carrying a bamboo bow, beside Menander, a tall olive man with wavy brown hair, bronze diadem, off-white tunic, bronze cuirass, dark green cloak, leather boots and iron spear, all in a palette of saffron, maroon, off-white, mustard and dark green.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two rival historical warriors standing side by side for consistent reference: Pushyamitra Shunga and Menander I. Pushyamitra is a late-40s, broad-shouldered north Indian man with a wheatish complexion, square face, stern gaze, thick brows and a neat moustache with short beard; his black hair is pulled into a high topknot at the crown, tied with a narrow saffron headband. He wears a knee-length off-white cotton angarkha-wrap tunic with overlapping right-side tie and thin maroon piping, over a sleeveless quilted mustard cotton coat with stitched vertical channels, a wide maroon cloth belt wrapped twice and knotted at the left, dark brown churidar-style trousers gathered at the ankles, and soft brown leather ankle boots with turned-down cuffs. A saffron wool shawl with a narrow red border is draped from his left shoulder across his torso, and he has simple bronze bangles and small gold stud earrings. His signature weapon is a long polished bamboo bow with a gently recurved profile, carried with a cloth quiver of feathered arrows on his back. Beside him, Menander I (Milinda) is a mid-30s, tall, athletic Indo-Greek king with light olive complexion, oval face, sharp nose, short beard stubble, and calm, piercing eyes; his wavy dark brown hair is cut to the nape and brushed back from the forehead, topped with a simple bronze diadem band. He wears an off-white linen short-sleeved chiton to the knees, cinched with a broad dark red leather belt, over which sits a plain bronze muscle cuirass with subtle engraved lines and a slightly green patina, the hem of the tunic showing a light blue border. A short dark green wool cloak (chlamys) is clasped at his right shoulder with a round bronze brooch and hangs to mid-thigh. He has simple bronze bracers on his forearms and knee-length dark brown leather boots with lacing. His signature weapon is a straight Hellenistic iron spear with a leaf-shaped point and bronze butt-spike, held in his right hand. Keep both men fully clothed, era-accurate, dignified and heroic, using a shared palette of saffron, maroon, off-white, mustard and dark green, and show them clearly head-to-toe with consistent face, hair, costume details and weapons.
